f3_program: observe(at("steve.earnings.target", "four_days"), 100, "dollar", source("make a total of $100 within four days"))
observe(at("berry_picking_job.pay_rate", "current"), 2, "dollar_per_pound", source("The job paid $2 for every pound of lingonberries picked"))

rate_relation(at("steve.earnings.target", "four_days"), at("berry_picking_job.pay_rate", "current"), at("steve.lingonberries.required_total_weight", "four_days"), source("The job paid $2 for every pound of lingonberries picked"))
produce("monday_harvest", "steve", at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), 8, source("On Monday he picked 8 pounds"))

produce("tuesday_harvest", "steve", at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), scale(event_field("monday_harvest", "quantity"), 3), source("Tuesday’s harvest was triple what he had picked the previous day"))
produce("thursday_harvest", "steve", at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), "steve.lingonberries.thursday_harvest.weight", source("pick on Thursday"))

sum_relation(at("steve.lingonberries.required_total_weight", "four_days"), event_field("monday_harvest", "quantity"), event_field("tuesday_harvest", "quantity"), event_field("thursday_harvest", "quantity"), source("On Monday he picked 8 pounds. Tuesday’s harvest was triple what he had picked the previous day. On Wednesday he felt very tired and decided to rest. How many pounds of lingonberries did Steve have to pick on Thursday?"))
query("value", event_field("thursday_harvest", "quantity"))
collection("anna.garden.lettuce_plants", "lettuce_plant", "garden", source("Anna wants to grow some lettuce in the garden"))
observe(at("anna.large_salads.minimum_required.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("at least 12 large salads"))
observe(at("lettuce_plant.large_salad_yield", "current"), 3, "large_salad_per_lettuce_plant", source("Each lettuce plant is estimated to provide 3 large salads"))
produce("grow_lettuce", "anna", at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.count", "current"), "anna.garden.lettuce_plants.grown.count", source("grow some lettuce in the garden"))

remove("lettuce_loss", "insects_and_rabbits", at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("grow_lettuce", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("half of the lettuce will be lost to insects and rabbits"))

difference_relation(at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.surviving.count", "after_loss"), event_field("grow_lettuce", "quantity"), event_field("lettuce_loss", "quantity"), source("half of the lettuce will be lost to insects and rabbits"))

rate_relation(at("anna.large_salads.minimum_required.count", "current"), at("lettuce_plant.large_salad_yield", "current"), at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.surviving.count", "after_loss"), source("Each lettuce plant is estimated to provide 3 large salads"))
query("value", event_field("grow_lettuce", "quantity"))
collection("ethan.candles", "candle", "ethan", source("Ethan makes beeswax candles"))
observe(at("ethan.candles.beeswax.weight_per_candle", "current"), 8, "ounce_per_candle", source("For each candle, he uses 8 ounces of beeswax"))
observe(at("ethan.candles.coconut_oil.weight_per_candle", "current"), 1, "ounce_per_candle", source("1 ounce of coconut oil"))
observe(at("ethan.candles.reference_count", "current"), 10, "count", source("10 candles"))
produce("candle_making", "ethan", at("ethan.candles.count", "current"), "ethan.candles.made.count", source("he makes three less than 10 candles"))
offset(event_field("candle_making", "quantity"), at("ethan.candles.reference_count", "current"), -3, "count", source("three less than 10 candles"))

sum_relation(at("ethan.candles.combined_weight_per_candle", "current"), at("ethan.candles.beeswax.weight_per_candle", "current"), at("ethan.candles.coconut_oil.weight_per_candle", "current"), source("8 ounces of beeswax and 1 ounce of coconut oil"))

rate_relation(at("ethan.candles.combined_weight", "current"), at("ethan.candles.combined_weight_per_candle", "current"), event_field("candle_making", "quantity"), source("For each candle, he uses 8 ounces of beeswax and 1 ounce of coconut oil"))
query("value", at("ethan.candles.combined_weight", "current"))
observe(at("group.shared_money.total", "current"), 50, "dollar", source("Tony, Moses and Esther are to share $50"))
percent_of(at("moses.money.share", "current"), at("group.shared_money.total", "current"), 40, source("Moses will take 40% of the total amount"))

difference_relation(at("group.shared_money.remainder", "current"), at("group.shared_money.total", "current"), at("moses.money.share", "current"), source("Moses will take 40% of the total amount while Tony and Esther will split the remainder equally among themselves"))

sum_relation(at("group.shared_money.remainder", "current"), at("tony.money.share", "current"), at("esther.money.share", "current"), source("Tony and Esther will split the remainder equally among themselves"))
same(at("tony.money.share", "current"), at("esther.money.share", "current"), source("Tony and Esther will split the remainder equally among themselves"))
query("difference", at("esther.money.share", "current"), at("moses.money.share", "current"))
collection("grant.baby_teeth", "tooth", "grant", source("All 20 of Grant’s baby teeth"))
observe(at("grant.baby_teeth.fallen.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("All 20 of Grant’s baby teeth have fallen out"))
observe(at("grant.tooth_fairy.money_received.total", "now"), 54, "dollar", source("a total of $54 from the tooth fairy"))
observe(at("grant.baby_teeth.dropped.count", "current"), 1, "count", source("one that he dropped on the way home from school"))

same(at("grant.baby_teeth.swallowed.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.dropped.count", "current"), source("one that he dropped on the way home from school and another he swallowed accidentally"))

sum_relation(at("grant.baby_teeth.fallen.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.placed_under_pillow.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.dropped.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.swallowed.count", "current"), source("Every time he lost a tooth, he put it under his pillow for the tooth fairy, except for one that he dropped on the way home from school and another he swallowed accidentally"))
offset(at("grant.baby_teeth.placed_under_pillow_after_first.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.placed_under_pillow.count", "current"), -1, "count", source("per tooth after his first tooth"))
add("first_tooth_payment", "tooth_fairy", at("grant.tooth_fairy.money_received", "current"), 20, source("The tooth fairy left Grant $20 when he lost his first tooth"))

add("later_tooth_payments", "tooth_fairy", at("grant.tooth_fairy.money_received", "current"), "grant.tooth_fairy.money_received.after_first", source("equal money exchanged for each tooth thereafter"))

sum_relation(at("grant.tooth_fairy.money_received.total", "now"), event_field("first_tooth_payment", "quantity"), event_field("later_tooth_payments", "quantity"), source("a total of $54 from the tooth fairy"))

rate_relation(event_field("later_tooth_payments", "quantity"), at("grant.tooth_fairy.payment_per_tooth_after_first", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.placed_under_pillow_after_first.count", "current"), source("assuming equal money exchanged for each tooth thereafter"))
query("value", at("grant.tooth_fairy.payment_per_tooth_after_first", "current"))
